test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the option in which the numbers are in correct ascending order.
solution:
Calculation:

1 over11, 2 over9, 2 over3, 4 over5

LCM of 11, 9, 3 and 5 is 495

Multiplying the above fraction by 495

⇒ {1 over11} times 495, {2 over9} times 495, {2 over3} times 495, {4 over5} times 495

⇒ 45, 110, 330, 396

**∴ Fractions only in option 2 are in the correct ascending order.**
